svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 170 mm of 42 mm OD PVC pressure pipe with a fine-tooth saw in a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mitre box, so both ends are square to within 0.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr inside and out; chamfer the outside of the bottom end 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Abrade 26 mm of the outside at the top (into the head socket) and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 15 mm of the inside at the bottom (over the fin spigot) with 120 grit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bottom end sits on the fin collar, glued over the spigot;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the top end goes 24 mm into the head socket, 2 mm short of its floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the head socket slides over the tube by hand with about

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 0.5 mm all round for the epoxy; the spigot slides into the tube.
